title: Reseller Partner Uplift on Duplicate-Charge Goodwill
content:
# Partner uplift

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts (reseller tiers)

The partner uplift of the duplicate-charge goodwill follows the account's current tier and its tier changed date: an account whose current tier is Harborline Reseller Gold or Harborline Reseller Platinum and whose tier changed date is on or before the duplicate's charge date adds $4.00; an account whose current tier is Harborline Reseller Bronze or Harborline Reseller Silver and whose tier changed date is on or before that date adds $2.00; any other account, including one whose tier changed date is after that date whatever tier it held before, adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the duplicate-charge goodwill figure.

## Basis Q&A (hypothetical dates)

- *Platinum account, tier changed 2 January, duplicate charged 9 June?* $4.00.
- *Silver account, tier changed on the very day of the duplicate charge?* $2.00; "on or before" includes the same day.
- *Gold account whose tier changed after the duplicate's charge date?* Nothing, whatever tier it held before.
- *Harborline Business Account?* Nothing.
